Dashboard.emptyTitle: Your dashboard is on its way
Dashboard.emptyDescription: Widgets for your tasks, calendar and more will appear here once those parts of Madeora are built.

Placeholder.title: Not built yet
Placeholder.description: {section} is part of Madeora but has not been built yet.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.description: This address does not exist in Madeora. Use the menu to find what you were looking for.

Auth.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A few unrelated words work well.
Auth.emailInvalid: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
Auth.passwordTooLong: Use at most 72 characters (fewer with accents or emoji).
Auth.passwordIsEmail: Your password can't be your email address.
Auth.invalidCredentials: The email address or password is incorrect.
Auth.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email address first. Check your inbox, or send the email again below.
Auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
Auth.weakPassword: This password isn't allowed. Choose a longer one.
Auth.samePassword: Choose a password that is different from your current one.
Auth.linkInvalid: This link has expired or has already been used.
Auth.network: Madeora can't be reached. Check your connection and try again.
Auth.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
Auth.passwordChangedNotice: Your password has been changed and every device was signed out. Sign in with your new password.
Auth.checkEmailDescription: If {email} can be used for a new account, we've sent it a link to confirm it. Open the link on any device to finish.
Auth.checkEmailSpam: Nothing after a few minutes? Check your spam folder, or send the email again.
Auth.resendSent: If an account with that address still needs confirming, we've sent a new link.
Auth.confirmDescription: Select the button to confirm your address and open Madeora.
Auth.confirmMissingToken: This confirmation link is incomplete. Open the link from the email again, or ask for a new one below.
Auth.forgotDescription: Enter the email address of your account. We'll send you a link to choose a new password.
Auth.forgotSent: If there's a Madeora account for {email}, we've sent it a link to choose a new password. The link works once and expires after an hour.
Auth.resetDescription: When you save it, every device signed in to your account is signed out, this one included. Then you sign in again with the new password.
Auth.resetMissingToken: This reset link is incomplete or has expired. Ask for a new one.
Auth.signOutEverywhereFailed: Your password was changed, but not every device could be signed out yet. Try again to finish.
